messages:
Mina: Hey team — new ask for the Serving Wins launch: create a "Pocket Playbook" micro-asset pack for reps and social. Small bundle: 1) vertical poster (1080x1920) for story + print-friendly A5 poster, 2) two micro-infographics (single-panel each) that explain latency vs cost in plain language, 3) a looping 6s GIF demo of the benchmark sparkline for socials, 4) a compact one-pager (email-friendly HTML) for SDRs, and 5) a slide-ready footer bar component (16:9). Need Figma prototypes and export assets (PNG @2x, SVG, GIF). Deadline: Mon EOD for first pass. @Jo @Eve
Jo: got it. A couple Qs: will the GIF be data-driven (animated dots) or a stylized sparkline? also need the CSV for precise points.
Mina: animated dots would be great but keep it subtle — 3 states: baseline, competitor cluster, recommended config. CSV here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE_POCKETCSV — granting view.
Eve: Brand rules: use Redwood Blue & Ink; maintain accessible contrast. For micro-infographics keep type large and avoid thin strokes — these show on small phones. Stacked logo for poster, horizontal for footer. I'll drop swatches in the Figma file.
Sam: copy for poster headline: "Serving wins: speed + savings" Subhead (1 line): "Lower per-token cost, predictable latency." Micro-infographic captions should be one-liners.
Tao: UTMs + HubSpot mapping for social/post landing: use template below and include hidden fields on the form.

```
utm_source=webinar_playbook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=serving_wins_playbook

HubSpot mapping:
- hs_source => "Webinar: Serving Wins - Playbook"
- hs_campaign => "serving_wins_playbook"
- hs_tags => "playbook_servingwins"
```
I will create the form and share embed after assets are up.
LegalBot: please attach provenance for any comparative numbers in the micro-infographics (CSV + API run IDs). No absolute percentages without source note. Will review Tue AM.
figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-playbook — pages: Poster, MicroInfographics, GIFFrames, OnePager, FooterBar. Shared with participants.
Jo: ETA for first comps: Mon 5pm. I'll include GIF frames, PNGs, SVGs, and brief alt text snippets on each component in Figma. File naming: servingwins_playbook_<asset>_<size>_v1.png.
Mina: perfect. After Legal signs off we'll tag the sheet row "approved_for_publish". Thanks all :rocket:
notes: Pocket Playbook micro-asset request for Serving Wins launch: poster, micro-infographics, GIF, one-pager, footer bar, plus UTMs and HubSpot mapping. Legal provenance requested.
